prompts.green: Use case: illustration-story. Reference image: approved war temple fresco, style and banner design reference. Make a transparent animation drawing sheet of ONLY the green banner cloth from that painting, no pole, no spear point, no background, no lettering. Two separate drawings side by side with ample transparent margin: first the cloth gently lifting in a breeze, second settling with a slightly deeper fold. Exactly the same green cloth, flat tempera brush facets and thin gold leaf edging as the reference, same double-point swallowtail silhouette. Cloth attaches to a vertical pole at its RIGHT edge and flows toward the left. Preserve warm painted highlights, no glossy 3D, no added symbols. Two full cloth drawings, identical apparent scale, left half and right half of a wide sheet. Actual alpha transparent background.
